name: Sarkale
desc: A Khan found leaning against a mesh gate at the mouth of [Firfire Caverns](location:firfire_caverns). Wearing the Darksteel Plate outfit, a scavenger as he so claims to be. Speaking of the caverns and advising the player to follow the various blue cubes scattered in the caves.
additional_info: -   The Aspect variant of Sarkale is Silverback
